verdict.rationale: Jan's local OpenAI-compatible server applies to this axis, but the documented endpoints are only /v1/models, /v1/chat/completions and /v1/messages. Nothing in the evidence shows an embeddings endpoint or support for serving embedding models for retrieval or search. A general API server and LLM downloads are adjacent capabilities and do not count as embedding-model serving.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve embedding models for retrieval and search applications
